author: MCKhanstent
quote:
This game is GTA in name only.

A 15+ hour long "slow burn" opening, boring as all hell. Sorry to say but if your game is boring for a third of the game then it's not good. And it doesn't get much better, if at all.

You have to drive the same beat up hunk of junk for most of those 15 hours because you can't steal a decent car since you don't have the tools to do so. You know what you've been able to do in every other GTA before? Steal a car that you liked from the get go. It was yours after saving it in your garage. Now? Well not only do you have to have the proper tools but once you steal it you have to jump through hoops to make it actually yours.Also, you know the relationship stuff that they said was optional? Yeah not really because it negatively effects your game. Plus, there's a KARMA SYSTEM in a game about BEING A BAD GUY.  Don't kill anybody while robbing just leave them crippled for the rest of their life. What are we doing here R*?

All this wrapped in a capped 30fps world full of bugs and that's not because it takes place in Florida.

author: MCKhanstent
quote:
This game is GTA in name only. The first 15 hours or so is so damn slow and boring. For anybody saying "but it's a slow burn" dog if a third of the game is ass then I'm sorry to say it's ass. It actually doesn't even get better.

They restricted so much and barely any of it makes sense. In previous GTA titles the bare minimum was that as soon as you saw a cool car you could hijack it and it was yours. Now you have to drive the same beat up piece of **** for hours because you aren't experienced enough to steal better cars. That's not all. Once you actually do steal one you have to jump through hoops before it actually becomes yours. Rockstar... da **** we doing here?

Aside from that, they said the relationship aspect was "optional" but it really isn't as you get punished for not interacting with it, and not only that, but there's a KARMA METER in a game that was historically, up until this point, about BEING A BAD GUY. Now killing while robbing is frowned upon. Don't shoot them in the head just leave them crippled for life at least they're still breathing right? Jesus.

It's just face palm after face palm where I'm left shaking my head at every other decision these devs made regarding this game. And to top off this diarrhea ice cream **** day is it's all capped at 30fps and there are bugs everywhere, and the bugs aren't because it takes place in Florida, more like because of characters falling through the map and cars disappearing.

**** this game. If you can get it refunded. They don't deserve your money.

author: MCKhanstent
quote:
Absolute cinema.

Awesome music? Check.
A ton of weapons that are all usable? Check.
50+ boss fights? Check.
An amazing looking world? Check.
Cool revenge story? Check.

Really this game had me by the balls for my entire 50 hour playthrough. Some minor environmental issues here and there but aside from that an absolutely phenomenal experience. They even added NG+ for people that really want to keep beating the dog piss out of the enemies. Unfortunately once I beat a game it's hard for me to want to play through it again but it's a nice addition for those that love replaying single player games. The game is a bit on the easier side, as even on hellwalker difficulty I didn't struggle too much against bosses. The power fantasy of you being a badass really is kept throughout the game. The beginning is a bit tougher but it gets progressively easier as you power up with skills, upgraded weapons, and accessories that help deal more damage, upgrade your defense, or boost your stamina so you can stay aggressive. I really wish the game had a super boss as an optional fight or "true" end boss but it seems most if not all of the harder fights are all tied to the story, which is a shame. For anybody that loves action adventure games this is a must buy. As a 40 year old I don't often buy games on release day but I had a good feeling about this one and I was not wrong. 10/10.
